Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerClaimsP:
How many vehicles one account can own at the same time.
0 stops new claims; vehicles already claimed stay claimed.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerMaxMemb: How many named players an owner can share one vehicle with.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerClaimDi: How close to the vehicle's body a player must stand to claim, unclaim or re-issue it. Any part of a long trailer counts.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerAllowFa:
When enabled, owners can let members of their faction use a vehicle.
Sharing pauses automatically if the faction is renamed, disbanded or gets a new leader.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerInactiv:
When an owner has not been online for this many days, their vehicles are unclaimed.
Players see their own deadline in the fleet window. Time while the server is down does not count.
0 turns this off.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerParkedG:
While no one is inside, the server keeps weapons from damaging claimed vehicles, repairs damage on a timer and puts back broken windows. It pauses while someone is inside.
By guard slots: each player can guard as many vehicles as Guard slots per player (admins can change it per player) plus paid slots (needs Minidoracat Economy). Slots go to the earliest claimed vehicles automatically; owners can change them in the fleet window.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerGuardSl: When Damage guard is set to By guard slots, how many vehicles each player can guard for free. Admins can change it for one player in the Admin tab of the fleet window.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerRelease:
When a player who can't reach a vehicle uses Unclaim lost vehicle, it is unclaimed after this many hours and stays claimed until then.
If the server sees the vehicle in that time, the unclaim is cancelled.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerTombsto: How long released, lost or destroyed vehicles stay in the owner's list before they are cleared.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerNameMax: Maximum length of a custom vehicle name. Chinese and Japanese characters use 3 bytes each.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerVirtual:
Owners and players they allow to drive can unlock, open without triggering the alarm and start their claimed vehicles without the physical key.
Off keeps the vanilla key rules.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerWatchdo: What the server does when someone sits in a claimed vehicle without permission. The server checks every occupant regularly; a modified client can still sit in the seat for a moment.
How often the server checks each online player for sitting in a claimed vehicle without permission.
Remove the player from the vehicle
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerRebindD: Claims imported from Mysterious Vehicle Claim Key become real claims the first time the server sees the vehicle. Imported claims not matched after this many days are dropped and written to the audit log.
